title: Practice words
description: Short words that pair a sibilant with a vowel, for the word drills. Each becomes a drill with the id w-<word>.

word.description: The word, in lowercase. Practice history refers to it, so never change one that has shipped.

sibilant.description: The sibilant the word starts with.

vowel.description: Vowel key from the formant table in src/dsp.js: i (ee as in heed), I (ih as in hid), e (ay as in hayed), E (eh as in head), ae (a as in had), a (ah as in hod), c (aw as in hawed), V (uh as in hud), o (oh as in hoed), U (oo as in hood), u (oo as in who'd), r (er as in heard).
